💾 Local
Manual
✓ Browser Storage
Always active. No setup required. Stores data in browser (~5MB limit). Used as the default and required fallback data source — cannot be turned off.
📂 File
Import / Export

Load or save the entire app database as a JSON file.

📊 Sheet
Semi-Auto

Paste the public JSON export URL from Google Sheets (File → Publish to web → JSON).

⚠ Sheet must be publicly published. Private sheets require OAuth (not supported here).

⚡ Supabase
REST/Realtime

Database Provider: Supabase

Connect to a Supabase (PostgreSQL) project for live sync across devices, via the Supabase JS client — no direct database connection string is ever used in the browser.

📍 Where to find these values: Supabase Dashboard → Project → ⚙ Project Settings → API → Project URL & anon public key.
✕ Never paste your service_role key or a Postgres connection string here — only the public anon key is safe to use in the browser.
🛠 One-time setup: run this once in Supabase → SQL Editor to create the sync table (open read/write for testing — tighten with real RLS policies for production): 
create table if not exists b2_tracker_data (
  id text primary key,
  payload jsonb,
  updated_at timestamptz default now()
);
alter table b2_tracker_data enable row level security;
create policy "public read/write (testing)" on b2_tracker_data
  for all using (true) with check (true);
Then enable Realtime for this table: Supabase → Database → Replication → toggle b2_tracker_data on.

Note: localStorage is always used as a live working copy. External sources (File, Sheet, Supabase) sync on top. Data Structure: { modules[], features[], users[], meetings[] }

⚠ Danger Zone

Permanently clears all Projects, Phases, Jobs, Tasks, Activities, Meetings, and related records from this browser, so the app opens with a completely empty dataset. Existing users, permissions, and settings are preserved. This cannot be undone — export a backup first if needed.

Optional. If configured, password reset links are sent via email. Otherwise, copy-link is used.
